units.summary: Adds a package-level hook, used only by tests, that runs between writing the blocks and evicting series. It stays nil in production.
units.headline: Add test hook that runs before head-view eviction
units.reason: Only tests set this hook; it stays nil in production.

units.summary: Declares a function type that builds a filtered head view for each chunk-range slice. The declaration alone has no runtime effect.
units.headline: Add headViewFactory function type
units.reason: Type declaration; the behavior lives in the function that uses it.

units.summary: Declares the evictor function type and documents the contract for the append-ID watermark. The declaration alone has no runtime effect.
units.headline: Add headSeriesEvictor type with watermark contract docs
units.reason: Type declaration plus docs; no runtime logic.

units.summary: Generalizes the old stale-head compaction loop. It captures an append-ID watermark, writes one block per chunk range, skips empty views, reloads blocks, then evicts series. Series that got appends after the watermark are kept.
units.headline: Shared head-view compaction loop adds append-ID watermark and skips empty views
units.reason: Changes the compaction and eviction logic, where a mistake can lose data.
focus: The watermark is captured before any block's isolation snapshot is taken
The chunk range is loaded on each iteration rather than once (pre-existing behavior)
Skipping empty slices (no UIDs) leaves no stray block directories
Blocks written on earlier iterations are not removed when a later reload fails

units.summary: CompactStaleHead now calls compactHeadViewLocked with a SelectedSeriesHead view and a stale-series evictor. The evictor now also checks the append-ID watermark.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead now delegates to the shared compactHeadViewLocked
units.reason: Changes the stale-compaction path: eviction gains a watermark check and empty slices are now skipped.
focus: SelectedSeriesHead.NumSeries now counts the refs passed in rather than NumStaleSeries
The stale-series hint is still set on every block

units.summary: Updates one comment to the renamed function gcSeries.
units.headline: Test comment renamed to gcSeries
units.reason: Comment-only edit in a test file.

units.summary: New test that appends a sample in the window before eviction. It checks the expected result before and after restart, for both isolation modes.
units.headline: New test: a late append during compaction survives restart
units.reason: New test; it cannot affect production.
